name: JWT & JOSE Libraries
description: Libraries that issue, verify, and manipulate JSON Web Tokens and the wider JOSE family (JWS, JWE, JWK/JWKS, JWA) across Rust, Go, JVM, Python, Node.js, Deno, and Dart — weighted toward security posture and algorithm coverage

groups.name: General Information
groups.description: Ecosystem, licensing, implementation strategy, and basic identifying information

attributes.name: Ecosystem
attributes.description: Runtime(s) the library targets; multi-runtime libraries carry every tag they genuinely support

attributes.name: License
attributes.description: From LICENSE / package manifest; dual-licensed projects carry both tags

attributes.name: Implementation
attributes.description: How the cryptography is performed: in-language, via the standard library, SubtleCrypto, a native binding, or a platform provider such as JCA

attributes.name: Repository
attributes.description: Canonical source repository

attributes.name: Package
attributes.description: Registry page: crates.io, pkg.go.dev, Maven Central, PyPI, npm, JSR/deno.land, or pub.dev

attributes.name: Documentation
attributes.description: Best documentation entry point for users

attributes.name: First Release
attributes.description: Year of first public release on the registry; informational rather than a ranking signal

attributes.name: Latest Version
attributes.description: Current stable version string, with pre-1.0 versions stated exactly

groups.name: Algorithm Support
groups.description: Signature and encryption algorithms the library actually implements, not merely mentions

attributes.name: HMAC (HS)
attributes.description: Symmetric HMAC signature algorithms; near-universal, so absence is notable

attributes.name: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 (RS)
attributes.description: The most widely deployed family, used by most OIDC id_tokens

attributes.name: RSA-PSS (PS)
attributes.description: Often missing in smaller libraries; a genuine differentiator

attributes.name: ECDSA (ES)
attributes.description: ES256K (secp256k1, RFC 8812) is a separate and much rarer capability

attributes.name: EdDSA
attributes.description: Edwards-curve signatures per RFC 8037; note whether registered as EdDSA or the newer curve-specific identifier

attributes.name: JWE Key Management
attributes.description: JWE key-wrapping and key-agreement algorithms; empty for libraries that do not implement JWE

attributes.name: JWE Content Encryption
attributes.description: Authenticated content-encryption algorithms available for JWE payloads

attributes.name: Deprecated Algorithms Available
attributes.description: Discouraged or unsafe algorithms the library still exposes; use "None of these" rather than an empty value when the library exposes none

attributes.name: Algorithm Extensibility
attributes.description: Users can register a custom alg implementation — powerful, but also an escape hatch around the library's own safety checks

groups.name: Security Posture
groups.description: Safe-by-default behaviour on the verification path, measured against RFC 8725 (JWT Best Current Practices)

attributes.name: Rejects alg: none
attributes.description: The unsecured JWS variant is rejected on the default verification path; an explicit, unmistakably named opt-in still counts as true

attributes.name: Algorithm Pinning
attributes.description: How the accepted algorithm set is chosen — what the API forces, not what the docs recommend

attributes.name: Algorithm Confusion Resistance
attributes.description: Resistance to RS256→HS256 key confusion: 5 = structurally impossible, 3 = runtime check, 1 = raw bytes accepted for any algorithm

attributes.name: Unverified Decode Is Clearly Separated
attributes.description: A distinct, plainly-named API exists for reading claims without verification, rather than a flag on the normal path

attributes.name: Default Claim Validation
attributes.description: Claims checked automatically on verification with no extra configuration

attributes.name: Audience/Issuer Required
attributes.description: The API makes it hard to verify without stating the expected aud and iss — required parameters or fail-closed defaults

attributes.name: Clock Skew Configurable
attributes.description: Leeway for exp/nbf/iat can be set; the default value is worth flagging when large or unbounded

attributes.name: Constant-Time Comparison
attributes.description: HMAC tag comparison uses a constant-time primitive, verified in source rather than claimed

attributes.name: Minimum Key Size Enforced
attributes.description: Rejects RSA keys under 2048 bits and HMAC secrets shorter than the hash output, per RFC 7518 §3.2

attributes.name: crit Header Handling
attributes.description: Behaviour for the crit header per RFC 7515 §4.1.11; ignoring unrecognised critical headers is a security-relevant spec violation

attributes.name: Nested/Recursive Depth Limits
attributes.description: Guards against denial of service via deeply nested JWE/JWS or excessive PBES2 iteration counts

attributes.name: CVE History
attributes.description: Published advisories against this package; only meaningful together with the comment listing IDs and fix status

attributes.name: Security Policy
attributes.description: A SECURITY.md or documented private disclosure channel exists

attributes.name: Independent Security Review
attributes.description: A published third-party audit or documented review by a recognised security team

groups.name: JOSE Feature Coverage
groups.description: How much of the JOSE family is implemented beyond signed compact JWTs

attributes.name: JWS (Sign & Verify)
attributes.description: The baseline; false for verify-only or sign-only libraries, with the direction noted in the comment

attributes.name: JWE (Encrypt & Decrypt)
attributes.description: Full JWE support, not merely the ability to parse the header

attributes.name: JWK Parsing
attributes.description: Can construct keys from JWK documents

attributes.name: JWKS Remote Fetch
attributes.description: Built-in retrieval of a JWKS from a URL, as opposed to parsing one you fetched yourself

attributes.name: JWKS Caching & Rotation
attributes.description: Caches the key set with TTL handling and refetches on unknown kid; unthrottled refetch-on-miss is a DoS amplifier worth noting

attributes.name: kid Selection
attributes.description: Selects the verification key by the token's kid from a key set

attributes.name: JWK Thumbprint
attributes.description: RFC 7638 thumbprints, ideally including RFC 9278 thumbprint URIs

attributes.name: Nested JWT
attributes.description: Signed-then-encrypted tokens handled end to end

attributes.name: JSON Serialization
attributes.description: Serializations supported beyond the compact form

attributes.name: Detached Payload
attributes.description: RFC 7515 Appendix F detached content

attributes.name: Unencoded Payload
attributes.description: RFC 7797 unencoded payload option (b64: false)

attributes.name: Key Generation
attributes.description: Can generate keys or key pairs suitable for the supported algorithms

attributes.name: X.509 Header Support
attributes.description: X.509 header parameters handled; note whether x5c chains are validated or merely parsed

groups.name: Key Handling & Integration
groups.description: Key ingestion, external signers, framework adapters, and API shape

attributes.name: Key Input Formats
attributes.description: Key encodings the library can ingest directly

attributes.name: External Signer Support
attributes.description: Can sign with a key it never sees — KMS, HSM, PKCS#11, or cloud signer — via a pluggable signer interface

attributes.name: Framework Integrations
attributes.description: First-party or de facto community adapters for web frameworks

attributes.name: Async API
attributes.description: Whether the API is synchronous, asynchronous, or both; WebCrypto-backed libraries are typically async only

attributes.name: Typed Claims
attributes.description: How custom claims are modelled — compile-time types, runtime schema, or a dynamic map

groups.name: Portability & Footprint
groups.description: Crypto backend, runtime portability, and supply-chain surface

attributes.name: Crypto Backend
attributes.description: The cryptographic implementation underneath; drives portability and FIPS options

attributes.name: Pure Language Implementation
attributes.description: No native or FFI dependency in the default configuration, verified with the ecosystem's dependency tool

attributes.name: Runs in Browser/WASM
attributes.description: Works in a browser or a WASM/WASI target

attributes.name: Edge Runtime Compatible
attributes.description: Works on Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, or Deno Deploy; null where the question is meaningless for the ecosystem

attributes.name: FIPS-Capable Backend
attributes.description: Can be configured against a FIPS 140-validated crypto module; validation belongs to the module, not the library

attributes.name: Dependency Count
attributes.description: Direct dependencies in the default configuration; informational, and not meaningfully comparable across ecosystems

attributes.name: Package Size
attributes.description: Published artifact size (npm tarball unpacked, JAR, wheel, crate); null where the registry does not report it usefully

groups.name: Ecosystem & Maintenance
groups.description: Adoption, release cadence, maintainer situation, and conformance testing

attributes.name: GitHub Stars
attributes.description: Repository star count; a dated snapshot, recorded in the comment

attributes.name: Downloads
attributes.description: Registry downloads over a consistent per-ecosystem window stated in the comment; ranks within an ecosystem only

attributes.name: Last Release
attributes.description: Date of the most recent stable release

attributes.name: Maintenance Status
attributes.description: Activity level based on releases and substantive commits over the last 6–12 months

attributes.name: Bus Factor
attributes.description: Regular committers over roughly the last 50 commits, not the all-time contributor list

attributes.name: Maturity
attributes.description: Production readiness, API stability, and track record of handling advisories

attributes.name: RFC Conformance Testing
attributes.description: Evidence the implementation is tested against the specs rather than only against itself

attributes.name: Documentation Quality
attributes.description: 5 = task-oriented guide with signing, verification, JWKS and key-management examples plus a security-considerations section; 1 = essentially undocumented
